title: Make urn:kith:chat:1 implicit when using only contains core
description: A stock JMAP client sends only urn:ietf:params:jmap:core in the using array. kith-jmap parse_request hard-errors if urn:kith:chat:1 is absent (lib.rs:37-39). Since urn:kith:chat:1 is the only application capability this server has, a request that declares only core should be treated as implicitly including urn:kith:chat:1. Change parse_request to: if using contains only urn:ietf:params:jmap:core (or is a subset of {core}), accept the request and proceed as if urn:kith:chat:1 were present. If using contains urn:kith:chat:1 explicitly, behavior is unchanged. If using contains unknown URIs, that is handled separately.
